title: Template placement
description: Schema for providers/<provider>/templates/<role>/<name>/placement.yaml — the shape this template deploys: node pools, sizing, default topology. Environments override pools by name in their own placement.yaml with shallow per-top-level-field replacement: each field an override names replaces the template pool's field wholesale (lists included — taints/disks are restated in full), omitted fields are inherited, enabled: false drops the pool.

node_groups.description: Each group expands to <count> nodes named <cluster>-<name>-<index>

name.description: Group name; part of rendered node names

count.description: Number of nodes in this group

disks.description: Disk sizes in GB, rendered as scsi0..scsiN (Proxmox) / root+extra (cloud)

placement.description: Index-aligned placement groups (node i -> placement[i]); shorter lists wrap around

tags.description: Extra Proxmox/cloud tags applied to every node in the group

taints.description: Taints this pool declares for itself, once (design: pools declare their own taints). Each entry: {key, value, effect}. The node label is derived mechanically: <P_NODE_ROLE_LABEL_KEY>=<pool name>.
